# Real-world fixture sources

Every file below came from a public GitHub repository at a pinned commit. No file was edited; see "Kind" for how each one was obtained. sec.gov, house.gov and senate.gov were not contacted. Collected 2026-10-30.

**Kinds**
- `asfound`: byte-for-byte copy of the file as committed in the repo (SHA-256 checked against the source).
- `cassette`: the repo commits a vcrpy cassette (YAML) that recorded a real SEC HTTP response. The response body was written out unchanged. Binary bodies were written as stored. Text bodies were re-encoded as UTF-8; vcrpy only stores a body as text when it decodes as UTF-8, so this gives back the original bytes.
- `slice`: the exact bytes between `<XML>\n` and `</XML>` of one `<DOCUMENT>` inside a recorded full-submission `.txt`. This is how EDGAR wraps the standalone primary document. A matching full-submission file is included where noted.
- `excerpt`: the leading lines of a large file (explicitly truncated).
- `generated`: produced locally by this collection step (only the pdfplumber text).

- **Form 4/A amendment:** not found.
- **House yearly index XML (`YYYYFD.xml` from `YYYYFD.zip`):** not found committed anywhere. ivanma9/CongressionalTrading only has parser code for it (`src/congressional_trading/parser/xml_index.py`, which reads `<Member>` elements).
